entities.name: Barrenton
entities.description: A place with a gate guarded by Bowen.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: A plane where every elf is charged from birth to strike back against ugliness and darkness.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard of Alara with a vast network of predation.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon who does not distinguish between servants and victims.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Speaker who prefers dominating the mind that rules the body.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Speaker who says death is no excuse for disobedience.

entities.name: Ayli
entities.description: A Kamsa cleric who urges pushing through the pain to heal the world.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Former ruler of Mirrodin whose reign is recalled by memnites.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Plane where reminders of Memnarch's reign skirr.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian whose creations are addressed by Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian Grand Cenobite who wants to unite the flesh.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Forged a swarm of skirges from the dead to safeguard his throne.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Speaker who compares a moat of water to one of fire.

entities.name: Llanowar elves
entities.description: Elves who leave one plant of each type untouched as nature's portion.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: Eldrazi whose pathrazers know only hunger and destruction.

events.summary: Geth forges a swarm of skirges from the remnants of the dead to guard his throne.
events.quote: From the remnants of the dead, Geth forged a swarm to safeguard his throne.

relations.quote: Reminders of Memnarch's reign still skirr across Mirrodin
